bounds.domain: Two pages and two task generations with asynchronous provider completion, bounded retry, task cancellation/recreation and shutdown/reopen.
assumptions: Weak fairness requires scheduler admission, one enabled provider completion and reopening after shutdown. Cancellation is an allowed terminal result. No wall-clock deadline is proved.

The finite domain has two evidence pages, two task generations, one retryable failure, one cancellation and one shutdown/reopen. A new generation represents changed evidence or recreation of a cancelled deterministic task id.
The model covers task retention and finalization only. Journal mutation and processor effects are checked by the real-runtime conformance tests, not modeled as separate database transactions.
